# Purpose
This generated header defines the full metrics catalog used by the `disco` codebase and collects metric metadata from many subsystem headers into one place. It includes the base metrics type definitions and the metric groups for network, socket, QUIC, send, bundle, verify, dedup, resolve, bank, PoH, shred, store, replay, repair, gossip, sign, snapshot, and execution paths. The file also declares metric names, offsets, types, descriptions, and converters for shared counters and gauges such as `link_slow_count`, `tile_pid`, `tile_status`, and `tile_regime_duration_nanos`, which lets other code read and publish metrics in a fixed layout. The arrays and size constants at the end provide the total metric set, link-specific subsets, and per-tile-kind metric tables used by runtime code to index and expose metrics without manual setup.
